scope.exposure: all E4 test panels previously exposed (E4 + circular audit); every result exploratory

artifacts.access: metadata now; payload decoding only after a coordinator release; identity-only for panels 3-8

panels.scoring_access: LOCKED: identity/join/checksum only after release; no scored diagnostics, filtering, PH or endpoint before separate owner scoring release

ordering.landmark_order: ascending history_id (model-specific), used ONLY for chart landmark order and deterministic tie-breaking
ordering.evaluation_order: ascending sequence_id (shared across models); all paired resampling uses this order
ordering.pairing_rule: rows are paired across models by sequence_id with identical canonical 32-token history digests; any mismatch stops for review; no unpaired fallback

symbols.canonical_history_digest: sha256 of canonical tokens[:, :32] as uint8 bytes, row-wise

oracle.suffix_convention: restart at stationary pi, emit first, transitions only between emissions
oracle.reference_row_rule: explicit minimum: 4 lowest history_id rows of panel 1 and of panel 2 per model, K1/4/32, moment error <= 1e-10; plus every released calibration/validation row K4/K32 moment check <= 1e-10 (ERROR_BOUND.md v2.1)

chart.landmarks: all 512 panel-1 resid_post_3/p32 vectors, raw 128-D, float64 Euclidean distances
chart.bar: largest strictly positive finite H1 lifetime; ties birth asc, death asc, index asc
chart.scale: midpoint (birth + death) / 2; edges with distance <= scale
chart.lift_solver: scipy.optimize.milp, zero objective, integrality all, threads 1, mip_rel_gap 0, presolve default
chart.gauge: s in (+1,-1) maximizing |mean(exp(i*s*phi) * conj(m32x + i*m32y))| on calibration landmarks; tie s=+1; phi <- (s*phi - arg(c)) mod 2pi; |c| must be finite and > 0
chart.sigma: median(d8_i) where d8_i = 8th smallest distance from landmark i to the OTHER landmarks (self excluded only)
chart.duplicate_rule: query with an exact zero distance: z = mean of exp(i*phi_j) over ALL landmarks at distance exactly 0; Invalid if 1 - |z| > 1e-8
chart.support_rule: |z| >= 0.2 AND eighth-neighbour distance <= support_radius; every validation row required
chart.gate_rules: support all rows; fidelity A >= .80; every one of 12 bins >= 8; overall resultant <= .30; criterion not met -> INCONCLUSIVE; Invalid (defect) -> FAIL_TECHNICAL

scores.unit_vector: u = (cos(phi), sin(phi)) of the saved extended phase
scores.control_angular_instability: flag (diagnostic only) rows with 0 < ||m|| <= certified moment-error bound; vector is the operational float result; never infer zero from a tolerance

precision.rng: numpy.random.Generator(numpy.random.PCG64(seed)); one rng.integers(0, 512, size=...) call per draw, shared by all models (joint whole-trajectory resampling in evaluation order)
precision.B4_lower: quantile(B4 draws from the SD draws, 0.05, inverted_cdf)
precision.pass_rule: every model: mde_upper <= .02 AND centered projected power >= .80; any other combination INCONCLUSIVE; report mde_lower, mde_upper and power
precision.B4_pass_rule: every model: B4 q.05 lower > .01; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (criterion_met=false)

numerical_bound.reference: tests/oracle_profile/independent_reference.decimal_suffix_posterior (job 0014, unchanged), digits 60, inside a decimal context trapping Underflow/Subnormal/Overflow/Clamped/InvalidOperation/DivisionByZero
numerical_bound.features_reference: exact algebraic cos/sin of multiples of pi/6 at 80 digits
numerical_bound.trig_reference: Taylor series at 80 digits with fixed N = 48 terms, exact-rational tail bound < 1e-75 on the analytic interval [0, 6284/1000], proved term-rounding enclosure
numerical_bound.outcomes: CERTIFIED if every row bound <= 1e-4; INCONCLUSIVE if some finite bound > 1e-4; FAIL_TECHNICAL on trap/nonfinite/range/moment-check violation
numerical_bound.coverage: every released calibration and validation row for every model; reference posteriors computed once per unique canonical history after the cross-model join
numerical_bound.instantiation: only after coordinator release; scored rows locked (AccessDenied without scoring release)
numerical_bound.process_law: separate reported Z_bound (ERROR_BOUND.md section 6): stored-vs-generating-law relative perturbation plus sampler TV with both adjacent CDF-boundary errors and 2^-53 grid quantisation; carried into later interpretation of the zero benchmark
numerical_bound.reference_score: assembled exactly in rationals from finite Decimal moments and unit vectors
numerical_bound.process_operational: P_op is the normalised stored-weight likelihood calculation (stored floats as exact reals), not assumed exactly stochastic or stationary

gate_policy: All gates must PASS for overall PASS. FAIL_TECHNICAL (overall FAIL) only for invalid input, integrity, certificate, implementation or numerical defects. Every valid computed criterion not met (fidelity < .80, B4 lower <= .01, inadequate or straddling projected precision, unsupported rows, bins/resultant, lift/chart/certificate unresolved, resource exhaustion) is overall INCONCLUSIVE with criterion_met=false and exact gate/values/reason preserved. First non-PASS gate ends the cohort; no retry, refit, threshold change or data replacement. Equalities follow the written strict/non-strict inequalities with no added tolerance.

resources.stage_label_rule: ledger entry label = <stage>__<label> (legacy <stage>:<label> also counted); stage totals are sums of charged_cpu_s over that prefix
